# netbox_supported_versions (Data Source)

The NetBox versions this provider release was tested against. Any other version only gets a "Possibly unsupported Netbox version" warning at startup, so compare a planned NetBox upgrade against this list before applying it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_supported_versions" "test" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `versions` (List of String) The supported NetBox versions as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.
